initial.title: [v0.92.1][AWS][runtime-v3] Cut warm Polis GPU startup with prebuilt artifacts and persistent EBS
initial.goal: Launch the proven two-node AWS Polis from sealed prebuilt Runtime and GPU volumes without cold compilation, package installation, or model download.
initial.required_outcome: A repeatable Terraform warm path uses the one-L4 g6.xlarge shape admitted by the current four-vCPU quota, reaches GPU and Runtime local readiness within 120 and 30 seconds respectively, reaches controller-observed Polis readiness within 270 seconds, preserves full #605 security and qualification behavior, and retains only exact authorized itemized warm volumes.
authority_boundary: #605 and PR #606 are the behavioral and security baseline
USD 20 is the aggregate AWS ceiling for preparation and validation
Production HA DNS TLS routing multi-region replication and 24/7 cutover are outside authority
operator_constraints: Never compile install packages use Git Snap or download models during normal launch
Use disjoint Terraform state for persistent storage and disposable compute
Keep immutable S3 as artifact authority
Bind exact AMI metadata KMS key AZ volumes seals and plans before mutation
Use three separate single-use paid authorizations
Always retain SSH access on both nodes with one shared key
Write run state only below the bound worktree
Do not exceed USD 20 including seven-day retained storage
initial.task_boundary: One preparation path plus one warm two-node Terraform launch path and truthful startup measurement; no production-control-plane expansion.
deliverables: Disjoint warm-storage and compute Terraform roots and state
Least-privilege deadline-terminated preparation node with IMDSv2 restricted ingress exact IAM and zero-disposable-residue receipt
Complete versioned Runtime Guardian ADL CSM Shepherd Vector validator driver schema fixture and dynamic-library artifact closure
Exact AMI facility ABI NVIDIA and CUDA inventory
Encrypted dm-verity sealed Runtime and GPU warm EBS volumes
Machine-inspected compute destroy-plan denial of warm-volume mutation
Minimal no-install guest activation scripts with read-only content and disposable scratch
Controller-monotonic and guest-boottime startup receipts plus qualification receipt
Three single-use action authorizations and aggregate cost envelope
Review-gated typed SPP risk correction support in csdlc-v2/src/store.rs
Repeated live warm-launch proof under USD 20
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Normal launch executes no Git Rust build toolchain install OS package manager Snap mutable dependency resolution or Ollama model download
AC-2: A separate warm-storage Terraform state owns only exact KMS-encrypted AZ-bound persistent volumes while compute state owns only attachments and disposable #605 resources
AC-3: Preparation produces the complete #605 Runtime Guardian ADL CSM Shepherd Vector validator driver schema fixture library Ollama and model closure with canonical dm-verity seals
AC-4: Exact Runtime and GPU AMI IDs metadata facilities libc NVIDIA CUDA and device ABI are bound into preparation authorization seals and both warm launches

AC-5: Preparation and compute plan destroy and cleanup evidence proves least-privilege IMDSv2 SSH IAM private-network deadline termination zero disposable residue and no warm-volume KMS snapshot seal or storage-state mutation
AC-6: Read-only sealed content and separate disposable writable scratch allow two launches without trusted-content mutation and exact configured models become simultaneously resident

AC-7: Each guest uses CLOCK_BOOTTIME from its cloud-init activation start to its own local_ready receipt; under the current four-vCPU G-family quota the GPU limit is 120 seconds, the Runtime limit is 30 seconds, and controller-monotonic apply-to-observed aggregate service_ready must be at most 270 seconds or remain failed

AC-8: Service-ready cannot emit before both seals models private Ollama Guardian Runtime health and authenticated HTTPS WSS; qualification-complete separately requires all #605 Shepherd ACC restart state degradation Vector log and shutdown assertions

AC-9: Explicit gp3 size IOPS and throughput artifact-byte full-initialization and per-stage budgets make the current-quota 120-second GPU path testable while stale cross-AZ partial dirty or mismatched volumes fail closed
AC-10: Preparation launch one and launch two use separate single-use authorizations under one aggregate exact-plan USD 20 envelope with no retry reuse
AC-11: Cost proof includes preparation both launches EBS performance S3 snapshots IPv4 requests and seven-day warm retention plus continuing daily monthly rate and exact extend delete action
AC-12: Deterministic proof one repeated live qualification and fresh exact-head review have no unresolved actionable finding before publication
non_goals: DNS ACM Route53 or load balancers
initial.plan_summary: Separate slow preparation from fast launch with disjoint storage and compute state, build the complete launch and qualification closure, seal read-only dm-verity content on two persistent AZ-local volumes, bind exact AMI ABI performance authorization and cost identity, then prove repeated warm timing and full #605 behavior.

steps.action: Implement disjoint storage and compute Terraform ownership plus exact AMI KMS AZ and destroy-plan guards.
Build the complete immutable launch and qualification artifact closure and dm-verity sealed warm volumes.
Implement no-install activation service and qualification receipts stage budgets and deterministic negative tests.

Use the current-quota one-L4 g6.xlarge shape for the final distinct authorized launch and prove GPU local readiness at or below 120 seconds, Runtime local readiness at or below 30 seconds, controller service readiness at or below 270 seconds, full behavior, cost, and exact residue.
Obtain fresh exact-head review fix every actionable finding and publish through typed lifecycle authority.

invariants: Normal launch has no compilation installation Git Snap or model download
Storage state alone owns warm volumes and compute state alone owns attachments
Preparation is least privilege IMDSv2-only deadline terminated and leaves zero disposable residue
Immutable content is dm-verity read-only and service writes are disposable
Exact AMI ABI KMS AZ artifact and volume identity is fail-closed
Both launch nodes and the preparation node retain SSH with one key and operator CIDR
Compute cleanup cannot delete warm volumes
Timing denominators remain monotonic explicit and separate from qualification duration

Under the current four-vCPU G-family quota the enforced timing envelope is GPU local_ready at or below 120 seconds, Runtime local_ready at or below 30 seconds, and controller service_ready at or below 270 seconds; 30-second GPU readiness remains a future optimization rather than an issue gate
Every paid mutation has a separate single-use authorization
Aggregate seven-day AWS spend does not exceed USD 20
risks: Preparation privilege or interruption leaves a reachable node or disposable AWS residue
Base AMI lacks a required facility or ABI and tempts launch-time repair
Artifact closure omits a #605 binary script schema fixture or library
EBS attachment verity activation or model page-in exceeds stage budgets
GPU model page-in exceeds the current-quota 120-second local_ready gate
Compute destroy plan can mutate warm storage
Trusted content receives legitimate service writes and breaks launch two
Timing receipts mix clocks or stop before the correct local_ready or aggregate service_ready denominator
Authorization reuse permits an unbound second apply
Persistent performance and retention charges exceed the aggregate budget
Preparation artifact identity drifts from reviewed source
stop_conditions: A normal launch requires compilation package installation Git Snap or model download
Preparation lacks least-privilege IMDSv2 SSH deadline or zero-residue proof
Storage and compute state ownership overlaps or compute destroy can mutate warm resources
Complete artifact or exact AMI ABI identity cannot be proven
Warm content is writable by services
Any action lacks its own single-use authorization
Seven-day aggregate cost would exceed USD 20
Timing cannot distinguish guest local_ready controller aggregate service_ready and qualification_complete denominators
Fresh review reports an unresolved actionable finding

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed before AWS mutation on preparation security state ownership identity review artifact closure AMI ABI KMS volume AZ authorization aggregate cost timing or cleanup ambiguity; after apply always terminate the preparation or launch nodes and destroy all disposable ENI security-group IAM and root-volume residue while preserving only exact authorized warm volumes; never retry under a consumed authorization or convert a missed startup target into PASS.
review_prompts: Can normal launch reach any compiler package manager Git Snap mutable download or model pull path?
Does the artifact closure reproduce every #605 runtime and qualification dependency?
Can compute state or cleanup mutate persistent volumes KMS snapshots or seals?
Are exact AMI facilities driver and ABI identities bound to both launches?
Are controller and guest timing denominators monotonic complete and unable to stop prematurely?
Can EBS performance and model bytes plausibly meet every stage budget?
Can any action reuse or exceed its authorization or seven-day cost envelope?
Can service writes mutate trusted content?
Are #605 SSH private-Ollama IAM and cleanup invariants preserved?
initial.review_scope: Exact #607 packaging warm-volume Terraform activation timing test documentation evidence and lifecycle paths only.
